thesis: The post-earnings pop has stalled: the stock has chopped in a 28-30 range for about 3 weeks, the Nov 6 high of 31.0 was a spike that closed at 28.49, and there is no fresh catalyst. The close of 29.12 sits above the mean analyst target of 24.5, with short interest at 21.5% of float, so a failed range can break sharply. Reward/risk of 1.76 is thin for a stock with leverage (debt 691.7M vs cash 230.6M) and trailing FCF of only 9.2M. The regime is risk-off at 0.9 confidence, with a half-day session and thin liquidity today, so entering now pays little for the timing and gap risk. The case to wait is to see whether the 27.55 stop zone holds or the range resolves.
